image_description: A close-up photograph of a young child blowing soap bubbles using a plastic wand. The child is holding the wand in their left hand (viewer's left) and has a large, iridescent bubble forming at their mouth. Several other out-of-focus bubbles float in the background. The lighting creates strong specular highlights on the wet surfaces.

While the bubble looks fragile, 'prone to bursting' is a dynamic property not fully testable in a static image unless it is currently popping. However, the visual cues support the classification.
